§6Disk Drives & HDDs§f

§aNo storage means no OS. No OS means no computer. Get a drive.§f
Computers have zero built-in persistent storage. Without a drive, everything you write vanishes on restart.

§6Options§f:
§bFloppy Disk§f: 512 KB, portable. Used to install OpenOS.
§bHDD Tier 1§f: 1 MB.
§bHDD Tier 2§f: 2 MB.
§bHDD Tier 3§f: 4 MB.

§6Installing OpenOS§f:
1) Put an HDD and a Disk Drive in your case.
2) Insert the OpenOS Floppy into the drive.
3) Boot up, type §9install§f in the terminal, copy OpenOS to the HDD.
4) Remove the floppy. Done.

§cWARNING:§f Reading costs 0.1 energy/KB, writing costs 0.25 energy/KB. Booting eats a chunk of your power buffer.
